fixtures.name: upd
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i AS id, (i % 1000)::INTEGER AS v, 'k' || (i % 50) AS s, CASE WHEN i % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i * 3 END AS n, CAST(i / 100 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS d FROM range(0, 50000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 10000)

fixtures.name: narrow
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i AS id, (i % 100)::TINYINT AS i8, (i % 100)::SMALLINT AS i16, (i % 100)::UTINYINT AS u8, (i % 100)::USMALLINT AS u16 FROM range(0, 1000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)

fixtures.name: nested
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i AS id, CASE WHEN i = 0 THEN NULL ELSE {'a': i, 'b': i * 2} END AS st FROM range(0, 100) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)

fixtures.name: dec_flba
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i AS id, CAST(-(i + 1) AS DECIMAL(30,2)) AS p FROM range(0, 5000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 1000)

oracle.sql: SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN id = 12345 THEN 4242 ELSE v END AS v) FROM read_parquet('{path}')

cli: UPDATE '{path}' SET s = 'brand-new', n = NULL WHERE id >= 100 AND id < 20100

oracle.sql: SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN id >= 100 AND id < 20100 THEN 'brand-new' ELSE s END AS s, CASE WHEN id >= 100 AND id < 20100 THEN NULL ELSE n END AS n) FROM read_parquet('{path}')

oracle.sql: SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN id = 9 OR id = 49995 THEN 7 ELSE n END AS n, CASE WHEN id = 9 OR id = 49995 THEN CAST(-1.25 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) ELSE d END AS d) FROM read_parquet('{path}')
